scope: Corollary 4 (Boolean noise sensitivity) of the manuscript “Average sensitivity of polynomial threshold functions” (preprints/Average-Sensitivity-of-Polynomial-Threshold-Functions-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 127 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 441f9f8a40930603), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 1 and d ≥ 0 be integers. If f = sgn(p) on {−1, 1}n for a real polynomial p of degree at most d, with sgn(0) = 1, then NSη(f) ≤ Cd √ η (0 < η ≤ 1/2), where C is an absolute constant.
